cards.back: Control in which a response reduces the deviation that elicited it.
A condition where state variables are constant in time because net rates of change are zero; flows may continue.
The membrane voltage at which the net current carried by a particular ion is zero.
A measure of how readily charge flows; in I = g(V − E), it scales current for a given driving force.
Blood flow through a tissue's microvasculature.
A spatial imbalance between air reaching alveoli and blood reaching their capillaries.
The virtual volume of plasma cleared of a substance per unit time, calculated from urine and plasma concentrations.
A response that helps maintain a regulated variable while potentially changing system load or reserve.
C = 1.34 × Hb × S + 0.003 × P_O₂ (mL/dL); hemoglobin and saturation dominate.
V̇O₂ = Q̇ (C_a − C_v); any three determine the fourth.
DO₂ = Q̇ × C_a; extraction = V̇O₂/DO₂, about 0.25 at rest for the whole body.
Lower content is offset by higher cardiac output and higher extraction, which lowers venous saturation.
C = U × V̇ / P: plasma volume completely cleared per unit time.
Inulin clearance ≈ GFR; PAH clearance ≈ renal plasma flow; filtration fraction = GFR/RPF ≈ 0.2.
Excretion = filtered load − T_m once load exceeds T_m; real kidneys show splay.
Below GFR: net reabsorption; above GFR: net secretion; use the unbound plasma concentration.
J_v = K_f[(P_c − P_i) − σ(π_c − π_i)]; positive means filtration out.
Net pressure falls with P_c; many tissues filter along most of the length, with lymph returning fluid.
Higher P_c, lower π_c, leaky walls (lower σ, higher K_f) or blocked lymph.
Rising P_i and falling π_i oppose further filtration until exhausted.
C_ss = P/CL; τ = V/CL; 63% at one τ and 90% at τ ln 10; halving clearance doubles both C_ss and τ.
About 20 kJ per liter of O₂; heat storage S = M − W − H_loss; ΔT rate = S/(mass × 3.5 kJ/(kg·°C)).
Closed-loop deviation e = d/(1 + G); G = (open-loop deviation / closed-loop deviation) − 1; proportional control leaves a residual error.
A changed set point is defended by working effectors; failure shows effectors overwhelmed or absent.
E = (RT/zF) ln([out]/[in]); about 61.5 mV × log₁₀(ratio)/z at 37 °C.
V = Σ g E / Σ g (conductance form) or the GHK equation (permeability form); it sits between E_K and E_Na, closest to the ion with the largest conductance.
E_K shifts about 61.5 mV per tenfold change; the resting potential shifts less because sodium permeability pulls it toward E_Na.
Depolarization moves a cell toward threshold, but sustained depolarization inactivates sodium channels, so the net effect depends on size and duration.
MAP − CVP = CO × TPR; Q = ΔP/R for any vessel or bed; CO = HR × SV.
1/R_total = Σ 1/R_i; the total is lower than any branch; opening a bed lowers TPR and diverts flow.
R = 8μL/(πr⁴): halving the radius multiplies resistance by 16; the law is a scaling guide for rigid laminar flow.
PP ≈ SV/C; stiffer arteries widen pulse pressure at the same mean pressure; MAP ≈ DBP + PP/3.
V̇_A = (V_T − V_D) × f; shallow fast breathing lowers it at the same minute ventilation.
P_ACO₂ ≈ 0.863 × V̇_CO₂/V̇_A: halving alveolar ventilation doubles alveolar CO₂.
P_AO₂ = F_IO₂ (P_B − P_H₂O) − P_aCO₂/R; hypoventilation lowers O₂ and raises CO₂ with a normal A–a gradient.
1/C_total = 1/C_lung + 1/C_wall; shunt fraction = (C_c − C_a)/(C_c − C_v), poorly corrected by extra oxygen.
F₀ = σ₀ × PCSA; about 25 N/cm² in the synthetic examples; force scales with area, not length.
Force depends on filament overlap: a plateau near 2.2 μm and a linear descent to zero near 3.6 μm.
(F + a)(v + b) = (F₀ + a) b; v = b (F₀ − F)/(F + a); v_max = bF₀/a.
P = F v is zero at F = 0 and v = 0 and peaks at F* = F₀[√((a/F₀)(a/F₀ + 1)) − a/F₀], about 0.31 F₀ for a/F₀ = 0.25.
Hemostasis (minutes), inflammation (hours–days), proliferation (days–weeks), remodeling (weeks–months); phases overlap.
Repair restores continuity, often with a scar; regeneration restores original structure and function and needs structure, function, lineage and controls as evidence.
Gap width W closes at 2v: t_c = W/(2v); fraction closed = 2vt/W; speed per edge = closed width/2/time.
Separate migration from proliferation, image the same fields, use independent replicates, fit a rate from several time points, and state what a flat culture leaves out.
Average open area at each time across independent experiments; report the number of experiments.
Rate = percentage points of area closed / hours, preferably from a fit across several time points.
If closure is nearly unchanged when division is blocked, migration accounts for most of it over that time.
A flat layer of one cell type shows effects on migration and division in culture, not on healing in tissue.
A regulated value can be held by different combinations of output and resistance; the cost appears in organ flow, extraction and effort.
Reserve = maximum capacity − current use; compensation uses reserve, so a normal resting value can coexist with little reserve.
Apply a graded challenge: reserve shows as how far the controlled value is held when demand rises.
Choose a measurement that could contradict it: challenge response, direct organ flow, venous oxygen or hormone levels, not another resting reading.
